user.title: PillPilot
user.description: Choose how the PillPilot panel appears in the sidebar, and where the medicine name autocomplete list comes from. You can change both later via Reconfigure.

data_description.panel_visibility: Controls whether the PillPilot sidebar entry appears. Each user can independently hide it from their own sidebar via Profile → Edit sidebar regardless of this setting.
data_description.medicines_db_url: URL the integration pulls the medicine name list from when you click Refresh. The default points at the upstream community list. If you maintain your own fork, paste the raw GitHub URL of your medicines_se.json here.

reconfigure.title: PillPilot — settings
reconfigure.description: Currently loaded medicine list: version {list_version} ({list_count} medicines). Toggle 'Refresh medicine list now' to pull the latest version from the URL below.

data_description.panel_visibility: Controls whether the PillPilot sidebar entry appears. Each user can independently hide it from their own sidebar via Profile → Edit sidebar regardless of this setting.
data_description.medicines_db_url: URL the integration pulls the medicine name list from when you click Refresh. The default points at the upstream community list. If you maintain your own fork, paste the raw GitHub URL of your medicines_se.json here.
data_description.refresh_medicines_now: Check this and submit to fetch a fresh medicine list from the URL above. The toggle is one-shot — it clears itself after the refresh runs.

user.title: Add medicine
user.description: Set up a medicine. Each section below covers one part of the configuration — expand or collapse them as needed.

identity_section.name: Identity
identity_section.description: Drug identity and dose. Picking a known medicine from the dropdown auto-fills ATC code and active substance.

data.name: Medicine name (search or type)
data.unit_count: Per-dose count (number of pills / drops / injections)

identifiers_section.name: Drug-database identifiers (optional)
identifiers_section.description: Varunummer, NPL ID, and ATC code. Auto-filled when you pick a medicine from the dropdown above; leave blank for free-text medicines.

data.atc_code: ATC code (optional — auto-filled if you pick from list)

schedule_section.name: Schedule
schedule_section.description: When to take this medicine. Daily fires every day. Weekly uses the days-of-week list. Monthly uses days-of-month (e.g. '1, 15' for 2× per month). Every-N-days uses the interval field below.

per_weekday_section.name: Per-weekday time overrides (advanced)
per_weekday_section.description: Optional. Leave all blank for the same times every firing day. Fill some to use different times on different weekdays (e.g. Mon-Fri 08:00, Sat-Sun 10:00). In per-weekday mode, an empty row means skip that weekday entirely.

data.times_mon: Mon — times (leave blank to use 'Times of day')
data.times_tue: Tue — times (leave blank to use 'Times of day')
data.times_wed: Wed — times (leave blank to use 'Times of day')
data.times_thu: Thu — times (leave blank to use 'Times of day')
data.times_fri: Fri — times (leave blank to use 'Times of day')
data.times_sat: Sat — times (leave blank to use 'Times of day')
data.times_sun: Sun — times (leave blank to use 'Times of day')

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure medicine
reconfigure.description: Update the medicine's schedule, dose, or owner. Each section below can be expanded or collapsed. Picking a different name from the dropdown won't overwrite ATC code or notes if you've already filled them.

data.name: Medicine name (search or type)
data.unit_count: Per-dose count (number of pills / drops / injections)

identifiers_section.name: Drug-database identifiers (optional)
identifiers_section.description: Varunummer, NPL ID, and ATC code.

schedule_section.name: Schedule
schedule_section.description: When to take this medicine. Daily / Weekly / Monthly / Every-N-days. Only the field for the chosen frequency applies.

per_weekday_section.name: Per-weekday time overrides (advanced)
per_weekday_section.description: Optional. Leave all blank for the same times every firing day. Fill some to use different times on different weekdays. Empty rows in per-weekday mode mean skip that weekday.

data.times_mon: Mon — times (leave blank to use 'Times of day')
data.times_tue: Tue — times (leave blank to use 'Times of day')
data.times_wed: Wed — times (leave blank to use 'Times of day')
data.times_thu: Thu — times (leave blank to use 'Times of day')
data.times_fri: Fri — times (leave blank to use 'Times of day')
data.times_sat: Sat — times (leave blank to use 'Times of day')
data.times_sun: Sun — times (leave blank to use 'Times of day')

error.days_of_month_invalid: Days of month must be a comma-separated list of integers (e.g. '1, 15').
error.days_of_month_range: Days of month must each be between 1 and 31.
error.days_of_month_required: Monthly frequency requires at least one day of the month.
error.days_invalid: Weekdays must be a list of integers 0-6 (Monday=0 through Sunday=6).
error.days_range: Weekdays must each be between 0 and 6 (Monday=0 through Sunday=6).
error.days_required: Weekly frequency requires at least one weekday.
error.ends_on_invalid: End date must be in YYYY-MM-DD format. Leave empty for no end date.
error.starts_on_invalid: Start date must be in YYYY-MM-DD format. Leave empty to start today.
error.interval_days_invalid: Interval must be a whole number.
error.interval_days_range: Interval must be between 2 and 365 days.
error.interval_days_required: Every-N-days frequency requires an interval (2 or more days).
error.times_per_weekday_invalid: Per-weekday times must be 7 entries (Mon to Sun), each as a comma-separated list of HH:MM times.
error.times_per_weekday_length: Per-weekday times must have exactly 7 entries (one for each weekday Mon to Sun).
error.times_per_weekday_required: Per-weekday times need at least one weekday with a dose time.
error.times_per_weekday_time_invalid: Per-weekday times include a malformed entry. Use HH:MM format (e.g. '07:00').
error.duplicate_prescription_id: Two prescriptions share the same id. Each prescription must have a unique id.
error.frequency_invalid: Frequency must be one of: daily, weekly, monthly.
error.times_invalid: Times must be in HH:MM format (e.g. '07:00' or '7:00').
error.times_required: Add at least one dose time.
error.invalid_type: Type must be Pill, Drops, or Injection.

snooze.name: Snooze
snooze.description: Defer a scheduled dose. The integration re-fires the dose-due event when the snooze elapses.

unmark_taken.name: Unmark dose as taken
unmark_taken.description: Remove the most recent "taken" record for a medicine — the inverse of mark_taken. Powers the panel's hover-undo and per-person Undo last action.

medicine_id.name: Medicine ID
medicine_id.description: The internal id of the medicine.

scheduled_for.name: Scheduled for
scheduled_for.description: Which slot to undo when a medicine has multiple times per day. Defaults to the most recent taken record.

refresh_medicines_database.name: Refresh medicines database
refresh_medicines_database.description: Pull a fresh copy of medicines_se.json from the configured URL (or override URL passed to the call). Updates the autocomplete dropdown the next time the Add Medicine form is opened.

url.name: URL override
url.description: Optional. If omitted, uses the URL configured in the integration. If you want to test pulling from a different fork without changing settings, pass it here.

backfill_from_catalog.name: Backfill from catalog
backfill_from_catalog.description: Walk every configured medicine and fill any empty NPL ID and ATC code from the bundled catalog by matching on the medicine name. Never overwrites values you've already entered. Catches up medicines added before automatic catalog auto-fill landed.
